$comment: TEMPLATE — copy to Docs/Specs/Active/<task>/reuse_map.json and fill in each element.

elements.$comment: One entry per UI element that has a clone mandate in SPEC.md § Reuse Mandate.
elements.$comment2: elementPath: the name (or hierarchical path) of the built prefab's GameObject.
elements.$comment3: sourcePrefab: path + ' guid:HEXGUID' (32 lowercase hex chars). If no real source exists, set IMPLEMENTER_BLOCKED — do NOT build from scratch.
elements.$comment4: keySpriteGuid: the exact sprite GUID the source element carries, OR 'any-nonnull' if the element must have *some* sprite (re-skin allowed). Leave blank if the element has no Image component.
elements.$comment5: builtPrefab: path to the prefab this implementation built. P1 reads its YAML to verify PrefabInstance lineage or sprite match.
